recipe.text: One-handed arming sword. Cube failed twice (blob then 83-stud depth) so built a clean composed visual (blade+wedge tip+crossguard+wrapped grip+pommel), all WeldConstraint'd to the Handle, unanchored. Grip fitted by pure frame alignment: grip_offset 0.4 studs, blade_up 18 deg, blade_in_arm 0. Swing has weapon channel swept 45 deg, arc sweep 94.5 deg, clip_self_intersect 0 after re-keying the strike. Fast timing windup0.12/active0.13/cooldown0.3; short reach 6, moderate damage 25. Primitive Parts persist natively so no save_mesh/meshUploads.
